name: [🎄] Trade a Brainrot
desc:
🧠 Welcome to Trade a Brainrot!

💤 EGGS GROW AND MONEY STACKS WHILE YOU SLEEP! 🤑

🥚 Hatch — Open eggs to get Brainrots, from common to super rare!
🤝 Trade — Swap Brainrots with NPCs and players to grow your collection.
💸 Earn — Get better Brainrots to make more money and climb the leaderboard.
🌟 Mutations — Some Brainrots have special forms that are worth more!

💻 Play Anywhere — Works on PC, Mobile, Tablet & Console. Full Controller Support!

⚠️ Join our community to trade more! Only trade using the in-game trade system.
